7300.sanskrit: abhyākhyāna, duṣpravāda, paiśunya, piśunavāda, durapavāda, paravāda [abhyākhyā]

examples.text: mā h'evaṃ, āvuso ariṭṭha, avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhācikkhanaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
taggha taṃ, bhikkhu, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yo tvaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhi
mā h'evaṃ, āvuso ariṭṭha, avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.

7302.meaning1: to misrepresent; to slander; to falsely accuse

7304.meaning1: (vinaya) reinstatement; reintegration; readmission (after a saṅghādisesa offence)

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu abbhān'āraho hoti. so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya, ahañ'hi abbhān'āraho, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan'ti, gantabbaṃ, bhikkhave, satt'āhakaraṇīyena, appahite'pi, pag'eva pahite.

7305.meaning1: as big as a storm-cloud; size of a thundercloud
7305.meaning2: of the size of a cloud
7305.commentary: (SNa) abbhāmattaṃ vā'ti valāhakakūṭamattaṃ viya. (JAa) abbhāmattaṃ'va khāyatī'ti mahāmeghappamāṇaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti, idāni kasmā evarūpaṃ dosaṃ abbohārikaṃ karosī'ti.

examples.text: anaṅgaṇassa posassa, niccaṃ sucigavesino, vāl'aggamattaṃ pāpassa, abbhāmattaṃ'va khāyatī'ti.

7306.meaning1: (gram) initial syllable of a reduplicated root; reduplicate syllable
7306.sanskrit: abhyāsa (see defn of abhyāsa in pāṇinian grammar) [abhyas]

examples.text: dvebhūtassa dhātussa yo pubbo, so abbhāsasañño hoti. dadhāti, dadāti, babhūva.
abbhāse vattamānassa sarassa rasso hoti. dadhāti, jahāti.

7307.meaning1: (gram) become the initial syllable of a reduplicated root

examples.text: abbhāsagatānaṃ dutiyacatutthānaṃ paṭhamatatiyā honti. ciccheda, bubhukkhati, babhūva, dadhāti.
māna kita'icc'etesaṃ dhātūnaṃ abbhāsagatānaṃ vakāra takārattaṃ hoti vā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ. vīmaṃsati, tikicchati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? cikicchati.

7308.commentary: (THa) maccun'ābbhāhato loko'ti ayaṃ sabbo'pi sattaloko coro viya coraghātakena, sabbavaṭṭanipātinā maccunā maraṇena abhihato, na tassa hatthato muccati.

examples.text: kenassu-abbhāhato loko, kenassu parivārito, kena sallena otiṇṇo, kissa dhūpāyito sadā'ti.
maccuno-abbhāhato loko, jarāya parivārito. taṇhāsallena otiṇṇo, icchādhūpāyito sadā'ti.
abbhū'ti tassa bho hoti, yo anicchantamicchati, akāmaṃ rāja kāmesi, akantaṃ kantu micchasi.

7315.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + kira + ti

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, rājā khattiyo muddh'āvasitto vāmena hatthena bhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena cakkaratanaṃ abbhukkirati, pavattatu bhavaṃ cakkaratanaṃ, abhivijinātu bhavaṃ cakkaratanan'ti.

atha kho, ānanda, rājā mahāsudassano uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā vāmena hatthena suvaṇṇabhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena cakkaratanaṃ abbhukkiri, pavattatu bhavaṃ cakkaratanaṃ, abhivijinātu bhavaṃ cakkaratanan'ti.
taṃ sutvā rājā tattha gantu'kāmo cakkaratanaṃ abbhukkiri. taṃ ākāse patiṭṭhāsi saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya.

7317.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + gaccha + ti

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.
evaṃ te kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchissati, abhayena rājakumārena samaṇassa gotamassa evaṃ mah'iddhikassa evaṃ mah'ānubhāvassa vādo āropito'ti.

7318.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + gaccha + i

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vedehikāya gahapatāniyā aparena samayena evaṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchi, caṇḍī vedehikā gahapatānī, anivātā vedehikā gahapatānī, anupasantā vedehikā gahapatānī'ti.
itiha tena khaṇena tena muhuttena yāva brahmalokā saddo abbhuggacchi.

7319.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + gañcha + i

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā sitaṃ pātv'ākāsi. atha kho tā devatāyo bhiyyosomattāya ujjhāyantiyo vehāsaṃ abbhuggañchuṃ.
ehi tvaṃ, tāta uttara, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ jānāhi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃ'y'eva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā
taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato

7321.meaning1: manner in which it has arisen; way in which it has spread

examples.text: [bhagavā'ti (syā.), dī. ni. 1.157, abbhuggat'ākārena pana sameti]

7322.meaning1: having arisen; having flown up; having ascended (into)
7322.meaning2: having risen up, having jumped up
7322.meaningLit: having gone up to the top
7322.commentary: (UDa) vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā'ti ākāsaṃ abhiuggantvā, vehāsaṃ gantvā'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā udumbarikāya paribbājak'ārāme sīhanādaṃ naditvā vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā gijjhakūṭe pabbate paccupaṭṭhāsi. sandhāno pana gahapati tāva'd'eva rājagahaṃ pāvisī'ti.

7324.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + gama + māna

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhuggamamāno duddikkho hoti musati cakkhūni, evam'eva kho, ānanda, dhammo pāsādo duddikkho ahosi musati cakkhūni.

7325.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + gahe + tvā

7327.meaning2: raises up; brandishes something in a threatening manner

7328.meaning2: raised up; brandished something in a threatening manner

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… jivhānibandhanaṃ hanusaṃhananaṃ hatth'ābhijappanaṃ hanujappanaṃ kaṇṇajappanaṃ ādāsapañhaṃ kumārikapañhaṃ devapañhaṃ ādicc'upaṭṭhānaṃ mahat'upaṭṭhānaṃ abbhujjalanaṃ siri'vhāyanaṃ

7331.meaning2: rises to go towards; starts for
7331.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + ṭhā + si
7331.commentary: (APAa) abbhuṭṭhāsi ca caṅkame'ti caṅkaman'atthāya saṭṭhiratane caṅkame abhivisesena uṭṭhāsi, abhiruhī'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā vihārā nikkhamma caṅkamaṃ abbhuṭṭhāsi. ambaṭṭhopi māṇavo vihārā nikkhamma caṅkamaṃ abbhuṭṭhāsi.
vihārā abhinikkhamma, abbhuṭṭhāsi ca caṅkame, catusaccaṃ pakāsanto, desento amataṃ padaṃ.

7334.meaning1: marvellous; extraordinary; unbelievable; astonishing; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ, satthāni nikkhipitvāna, māṇavā etadabravuṃ.
sattahi, bhikkhave, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhāretha.

yañ'ca kho, omāti, bhante, bhagavā iddhiyā manomayena kāyena brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamituṃ, yañ'ca kho abhijānāti, bhante, bhagavā iminā cātumahābhūtikena kāyena iddhiyā brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamitā, ta'y'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavato acchariyañ'c'eva abbhutañ'cā'ti.

7337.meaning1: leading to the extraordinary; going to the unbelievable
7337.commentary: (SNa) abhūtam'eva bhūtaṃ ajātaṃ hutvā atthī'ti vā abbhutaṃ.

examples.text: abbhutañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi abbhutagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

7338.meaning1: struck with wonder; with hearts full of astonishment
7338.commentary: (MNa) acchariy'abbhutacittajātā'ti aho acchariyaṃ, aho abbhutan'ti evaṃ sañjāt'ācchariy'ābbhutā c'eva sañjātatuṭṭhino ca ahesuṃ uppannabalavasomanassā.

examples.text: tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca acchariy'abbhutacittajātā ahesuṃ, acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, samaṇassa mah'iddhikatā mah'ānubhāvatā'ti!

7339.meaning1: marvellous accounts; unbelievable stories; one of the nine kinds of suttas
7339.commentary: (MNa) cattāro'me, bhikkhave, acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande'tiādinayappavattā sabbe'pi acchariya-abbhutadhamma-ppaṭisaṃyuttā sutt'antā abbhutadhamman'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ
idha, bhikkhave, ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti, suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
cattāro'me, bhikkhave, acchariyā abbhutadhammā ānande. katame cattāro?

7341.meaning1: having extraordinary qualities; with marvellous characteristics

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhante, āyasmā ānando amhe etadavoca, acchariyā c'eva, āvuso, tathāgatā acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca, abbhutā c'eva, āvuso, tathāgatā abbhutadhammasamannāgatā cā'ti. ayaṃ kho no, bhante, antarākathā vippakatā, atha bhagavā anuppatto'ti.

7342.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of abbhutadhamma
7342.meaning1: as marvellous accounts; as unbelievable stories
7342.commentary: (ANa) suttaso'ti suttato, suttabhāvenā'ti attho. sesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho, puriso aggarasaparititto na aññesaṃ hīnānaṃ rasānaṃ piheti, evam'evaṃ kho, bho, yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti, yadi suttaso, yadi geyyaso, yadi veyyākaraṇaso, yadi abbhutadhammaso, tato tato na aññesaṃ puthu-samaṇabrāhmaṇa-ppavādānaṃ piheti.

7343.grammar: aor of abbhutaṃ karoti, comp vb
7343.meaning1: placed a bet; made a wager
7343.commentary: (VINa) abbhutam'akaṃsū'ti yadi karissati tvaṃ ettakaṃ jito, yadi na karissati ahaṃ ettakan'ti paṇam'akaṃsu. bhikkhūnaṃ pana abbhutaṃ kātuṃ na vaṭṭati. yo karoti parājitena dātabban'ti mahāpaccariyaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, karissati na karissatī'ti abbhutam'akaṃsu.

7345.meaning1: amazed and delighted; stunned; blown away
7345.commentary: (SNa) abbhutavittajātā'ti abhūtapubbāya tuṭṭhiyā samannāgatā. (SNt) abbhutavittajātā'ti sañjātaabbhutavittā. vittaṃ vittī'ti ca tuṭṭhipariyāyā.

examples.text: atha kho sā parisā abbhutavittajātā ahosi, acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho! ayañ'hi mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo n'eva mātaraṃ abhivādeti, na pitaraṃ abhivādeti, na ācariyaṃ abhivādeti, na jeṭṭhabhātaraṃ abhivādeti, atha ca pana samaṇe gotame evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karotī'ti.

7346.grammar: ind, excl, acc sg of abbhuta

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante!
acchariyaṃ, moggallāna, abbhutaṃ, moggallāna! yāva bāhāgahaṇā'pi nāma so moghapuriso āgamessatī'ti

7347.meaning1: places a bet; makes a wager

7349.grammar: aor of abhi ud ā √har, trans (+acc)
7349.meaningLit: carried up here to the top
7349.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + ā + hā + si

examples.text: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo viṭaṭūbhaṃ senāpatiṃ āmantesi, ko nu kho, senāpati, imaṃ kathāvatthuṃ rāj'antepure abbhudāhāsī'ti? sañjayo, mahārāja, brāhmaṇo ākāsagotto'ti.

7350.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + īraya + ti

7351.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + īre + ti

7352.meaning1: comes into being; arises into existence
7352.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + e + ti

7353.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + e + ti

examples.text: yato ca, bhikkhave, verocano abbhudeti yattha ca attham'eti, idaṃ tatiyaṃ suvidūravidūre. satañ'ca, bhikkhave, dhammo asatañ'ca dhammo, idaṃ catutthaṃ suvidūravidūre.

7357.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + nama + ti

7358.meaning1: having welled up; having sprung forth; having burst forth (from)

examples.text: udakaṃ sālato'pi abbhunnamitvā bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.

7359.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + name + ti

7360.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + nāme + ti

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana, bho gotama, yānagato samāno patodalaṭṭhiṃ abbhunnāmeyyaṃ, yānā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccorohanaṃ dhāretu.

7361.meaning1: having straightened up; having held oneself upright
7361.meaningLit: having caused to completely bend up
7361.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + nāme + tvā

examples.text: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abbhunnāmetvā kāyaṃ anuviloketvā parisaṃ bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, pañcahi, bho gotama, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti, brāhmaṇo'smī'ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyya.
sā… sappassa nikkhaman'okāsaṃ katvā, abbhumme anto sappo'ti vīṇaṃ chaḍḍetvā palāyi
assosi kho rājā pasenadi kosalo, rājā kira māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā mamaṃ abbhuyyāto yena kāsī'ti.

7364.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + yā + ti

examples.text: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ abbhuyyāsi yena kāsi.

7367.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + sakka + māna

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

7370.meaning2: oh horror!; terrible!; awful!; monstrous!; aaargh!

7371.meaning1: (vinaya) should be rehabilitated; should be reintegrated; should be readmitted
7371.commentary: (VINa) abbhetabbo'ti abhietabbo sampaṭicchitabbo, abbhānakammavasena osāretabbo'ti vuttaṃ hoti, avhātabbo'ti vā attho.

examples.text: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.
saṅgh'ādiseso'ti saṅgho'va tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ deti, mūlāya paṭikassati, mānattaṃ deti, abbheti, na sambahulā, na ekapuggalo. tena vuccati, saṅgh'ādiseso'ti.
ekena'pi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
ahaṃ kho'mhi abbhokāsiko, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na abbhokāsikā'ti. so tena abbhokāsikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.

7374.meaning1: open space; open air; wide open space
7374.commentary: (MNa) abbhokāsan'ti acchannaṃ, ākaṅkhamāno pan'ettha cīvarakuṭiṃ katvā vasati. (ANa) alaggan'aṭṭhena abbhokāso viyā'ti abbhokāso.

examples.text: sambādho ghar'āvāso raj'āpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā. na'y'idaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ek'antaparipuṇṇaṃ ek'antaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.

7375.meaning1: in the open air; out in the open; outside

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gām'antasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam'eva hoti, etā gāvo'ti.
tañ'ca nāgaṃ passati rukkhamūlagataṃ vā abbhokāsagataṃ vā gacchantaṃ vā tiṭṭhantaṃ vā nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā. so niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, ayam'eva so mahānāgo'ti.

7376.meaning1: wide open place; place open to the air

7377.meaning1: ascetic who lives in the open air; open-air dweller
7377.meaning2: who lives in the open air
7377.construction:
abhi > abhy > abbh + ava + √kās + a + ika
abbhokāsa + ika

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, abbhokāsikassa abbhokāsikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.
ahaṃ kho'mhi abbhokāsiko, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na abbhokāsikā'ti. so tena abbhokāsikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.

7378.meaning1: ascetic practice of living in the open air
7378.meaning2: practice of living in the open air
7378.commentary: (VISM) abbhokāsik'aṅgam'pi channañ'ca rukkhamūlañ'ca paṭikkhipāmi, abbhokāsik'aṅgaṃ samādiyāmī'ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ek'āsanik'aṅgaṃ pattapiṇḍik'aṅgaṃ khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ āraññik'aṅgaṃ rukkhamūlik'aṅgaṃ abbhokāsik'aṅgaṃ sosānik'aṅgaṃ

7379.meaning1: fact of being an ascetic who lives in the open air; fact of being an open-air dweller
7379.construction:
abhi > abhy > abbh + ava + √kās + a + ika + tta
abbhokāsika + tta

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi abbhokāsiko, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na abbhokāsikā'ti. so tena abbhokāsikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
so paṭipadaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ karitvā tena abbhokāsikattena n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, sappurisadhammo.

7380.meaning1: mere fact of living in the open air

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, udakorohakassa udakorohaṇamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlikassa rukkhamūlikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, abbhokāsikassa abbhokāsikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.

7381.meaningLit: discourse on living in the open air

7382.meaning2: living in the open; in the open air

7386.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ava + kira + ti

7388.construction: na > a + vi > vy > by + agga
7388.commentary: (DNa) nān'ārammaṇe paribbhamanena vividhaṃ aggaṃ etassā'ti byaggo, vikkhepo. tathā hi so anavaṭṭhānaraso, bhantatāpaccupaṭṭhāno ca vutto, ek'aggatābhāvato byaggapaṭipakkho'ti abyaggo, samādhi.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ abyagganimittaṃ. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.

7389.meaning1: basis for non-distraction; sign of non-dispersal
7389.commentary: (SNa) samathanimittan'ti samatho'pi samathanimittaṃ, ārammaṇam'pi. abyagganimittan'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ. (VINt) samathanimittan'ti ca samathass'ev'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, avikkhepaṭṭhena ca tass'eva abyagganimittan'ti.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ abyagganimittaṃ. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.

341, 336. aṃ vibhattīnam'akār'antā abyayībhāvā.
tasmā akār'antā abyayībhāvasamāsā parāsaṃ vibhattīnaṃ kvaci aṃ hoti. adhicittaṃ, yathāvuḍḍhaṃ, upakumbhaṃ, yāvajīvaṃ, tiropabbataṃ, tiropākāraṃ, tirokuṭṭaṃ, antopāsādaṃ.
napuṃsake vattamānassa abyayībhāvasamāsassa liṅgassa saro rasso hoti. kumārīsu adhikicca pavattati kathā iti adhikumāri. upavadhu, upagaṅgaṃ, upamaṇikaṃ.
